11. Let vapour density be $x$.
$\therefore$ Empirical formula mass = $x$
$\therefore n = \frac{2 \times \text{vapour density}}{\text{Empirical formula mass}} = \frac{2.x}{x} = 2$
Molecular formula = $(\mathrm{CH}_4\mathrm{N})_2 = \mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_8\mathrm{N}_2$
The number of carbon atoms is 2.
$\mathrm{Na}_2\mathrm{CO}_3 \to 1$, carbon atoms; $\mathrm{Al}_2(\mathrm{CO}_3)_3 \to 3$
$\mathrm{Ca}(\mathrm{HCO}_3)_2 \to 2$ Carbon atoms
Hence, the correct option is (b).

12. $2\mathrm{SO}_2 + \mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\mathrm{SO}_3$
Volume ratio of reactants = 2:1 ( $\because n \alpha v$)
$\mathrm{H}_2 + \mathrm{Cl}_2 \rightarrow 2\mathrm{HCl}$
Volume ratio of reactants = 1:1
$2\mathrm{CO} + \mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO}_2$
Volume ratio of reactants = 2:1
$\mathrm{N}_2 + 3\mathrm{H}_2 \rightarrow 2\mathrm{NH}_3$
Volume ratio of reactants = 1:3
$\mathrm{N}_2 + \mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\mathrm{NO}$
Volume ratio of reactants = 1:1
Hence, the correct option is (b).

13. Amounts of pure $\mathrm{NaHCO}_3$ in 105 g sample
$$ = \frac{70 \times 105}{100} = 73.5 \text{ g} $$
No. of moles of $\mathrm{NaHCO}_3 = \frac{73.5}{84} = 0.875$$

$2\mathrm{NaHCO}_3 \rightarrow \mathrm{Na}_2\mathrm{CO}_3 + \mathrm{CO}_2 + \mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
1 mole of $\mathrm{NaHCO}_3 \rightarrow 0.5$ moles of $\mathrm{CO}_2$
0.875 mole of $\mathrm{NaHCO}_3 \rightarrow 0.875 \times 0.5 = 0.437$
mole $\mathrm{CO}_2$
1 mole of $\mathrm{CO}_2 \rightarrow 22.4$ $\lambda$ at STP
0.437 mole of $\mathrm{CO}_2 \rightarrow 22.4 \times 0.437 = 9.8$ $\lambda$ at STP
Hence, the correct option is (c).

14. According to Graham's law, $r \alpha \frac{1}{\sqrt{\text{GMM}}}$

$$ \therefore r_{\mathrm{O}_2} : r_{\mathrm{SO}_3} : r_{\mathrm{O}_3} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{32}} : \frac{1}{\sqrt{80}} : \frac{1}{\sqrt{48}} $$

$$ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{16 \times 2}} : \frac{1}{\sqrt{16 \times 5}} : \frac{1}{\sqrt{16 \times 3}} $$

$$ = \frac{1}{4\sqrt{2}} : \frac{1}{4\sqrt{5}} : \frac{1}{4\sqrt{3}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} : \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} : \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} $$

Hence, the correct option is (c).
